public.name: Dreamstime
public.logo_note: No permitted logo URL confirmed; use text wordmark until Dreamstime brand/banner assets are pulled from the affiliate dashboard (needs account check)
public.summary: Upload your own photos and videos to a long-running stock agency and earn royalties when customers license them.
public.description: Dreamstime is a stock photo and video marketplace. Contributors upload their images, the agency reviews them, and contributors earn a royalty each time a customer licenses one. Income depends on approvals and sales and is not guaranteed.
public.user_requirements: Own the rights to the images you upload; Dreamstime reviews submissions (details on Dreamstime).
public.disclosure: 8Tasks may earn a commission if you join through this link.

public.name: JoinBrands
public.logo_note: No permitted logo confirmed: needs account check for brand assets
public.summary: Create photos and short videos for brands and get paid per job, often with the product supplied.
public.description: JoinBrands connects creators with brands that need user-generated content such as product photos, unboxing and demo videos, and reviews. Brands post jobs; creators apply; pay and any product depend on each job. A large following is not always required. Some jobs supply a free product, which is not cash pay.
public.countries_note: Official help lists eligible creator countries incl. Canada and US (also UK, Germany, Australia; out-of-market countries are not listed on 8Tasks)

compensation.display: Pay varies by job; some jobs include a free product (not cash)

public.user_requirements: 18+; one account per person; brand approval per job (per JoinBrands help).
public.disclosure: 8Tasks may earn a commission if you join through this link.
